mechanism_narrative: Sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy environment that reduces equity discount rates and stimulates risk asset demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates persistent labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending growth, triggering negative equity returns as corporate earnings face demand constraints over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 830 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 420 billion indicates weak consumer demand despite housing activity, causing negative equity returns as sales momentum deteriorates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances meeting the HOUST/RSAFS threshold condition.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 99 during post-2008 recovery phases signals manufacturing sector strength that correlates with rising corporate profits and positive equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO > 99 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 233.5 index points indicates accelerating price pressures that prompt central bank rate hikes, causing negative equity returns as discount rates rise over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 233.5 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls growth above 136,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS > 136,000 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 830 thousand units indicates strong residential construction activity that precedes consumer spending growth, driving positive equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST > 830 during the 2005-2024 sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 99 combined with federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates synchronized monetary stimulus and manufacturing strength, causing positive equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances meeting the INDPRO/FEDFUNDS threshold condition.
